prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Interact with Your New Desktop Pet", "Use system tray controls to hide or reveal your pet anytime. Press Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P to open quick pet commands."]
1: ["Confirm Your Pet's Appearance & Profile", "Verify your pet traits and preview render before we bring your companion to life on your desktop."]
2: ["Preparing Desktop Environment for Your Pet", "We are calibrating screen boundaries and rendering pet animations. Your desktop pet will spawn shortly.", "Checking screen resolution and system tray setup...", "Tip: Right-click the pet anytime to open commands or pause animations."]
3: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Journey", "Choose an instant preset pet (ready in 30s) or create a custom pet (photo setup ~2 mins)."]
4: ["Signing in with your existing account automatically restores all previously created pets and custom data."]
5: ["Attachment status: Initializing display layer... Loading graphics renderer... Tray icon ready."]
6: ["Never Lose Track of Your Desktop Pet", "If your pet disappears behind windows, click the pet icon in your taskbar or system tray to bring it back to front."]
7: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best generation quality, upload well-lit photos facing forward with clear contrast against the background."]
8: ["Unsure? Preset pets launch instantly and can be customized with extra traits anytime later in settings."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Right-click your pet for commands, voice interactions, & sound toggles. Click and drag to reposition anywhere on screen."]
